protocol: Western Blot in Stromal vesicle transfer reshapes fibroblast heterogeneity in pancreatic tumors
protocol_content: Cell lysates were prepared in RIPA lysis buffer with an EDTA-free protease inhibitor cocktail and cleared at 14000 x g for 15 minutes at 4 C. Protein concentration was measured by BCA assay against a BSA standard curve. Twenty micrograms of protein per sample were diluted in Laemmli sample buffer to a final volume of 25 uL. Samples probed for tetraspanin markers were loaded without heating and run under non-reducing conditions. Lysates were separated on a 4 to 12 percent Bis-Tris gradient gel and transferred onto a methanol-activated PVDF membrane. Membranes were blocked in 5 percent non-fat milk in TBST for 1 hour at room temperature, then incubated overnight at 4 C in primary antibody. Secondary antibody incubation was 1 hour at room temperature. Membranes were developed with ECL substrate. SYNTHETIC SAMPLE DATA. This paper does not exist.

protocol: Western Blot in Macrophage polarization in response to tumor-derived extracellular vesicles
protocol_content: Primary macrophages were homogenized in urea lysis buffer with protease inhibitors added. For assessment of kinase activation, a phosphatase inhibitor cocktail was included. Protein lysates were normalized by BCA protein assay and loaded onto acrylamide gels for electrophoretic separation under denaturing conditions, then transferred onto PVDF membranes by semi-dry transfer. Membranes were blocked for 2 hours at room temperature in 5 percent BSA in TBS with 0.1 percent Tween-20 and incubated overnight at 4 C with primary antibodies. Washes after antibody incubation were performed five times at 5 minute intervals. SYNTHETIC SAMPLE DATA. This paper does not exist.

protocol: Western Blot in A benchmark of vesicle isolation methods for downstream proteomic analysis
protocol_content: Vesicle preparations from each isolation method were lysed in Laemmli sample buffer. Protein was quantified by fluorometric protein assay rather than BCA, because residual polymer from the precipitation arm interferes with the BCA reaction. Equal particle counts rather than equal protein mass were loaded, since protein mass differs systematically between methods. Samples were separated on a 4 to 12 percent Bis-Tris gel and transferred to PVDF. Membranes were probed for CD9, CD63, CD81, TSG101, and calnexin as a negative control for cellular contamination. protocol: Immunofluorescence in Single-cell resolution mapping of hypoxic niches in solid tumor models
protocol_content: Sections were fixed in 4 percent paraformaldehyde for 15 minutes at room temperature, permeabilized in 0.1 percent Triton X-100 for 10 minutes, and blocked in 5 percent normal donkey serum for 1 hour. Primary antibodies were applied overnight at 4 C in a humidified chamber. After three washes in PBS, fluorophore-conjugated secondary antibodies were applied for 1 hour at room temperature in the dark. Nuclei were counterstained with DAPI. Sections were mounted in anti-fade medium and imaged on a confocal microscope with identical acquisition settings across all conditions. SYNTHETIC SAMPLE DATA. This paper does not exist.

protocol: Flow cytometry in Macrophage polarization in response to tumor-derived extracellular vesicles
protocol_content: Cells were harvested with a non-enzymatic dissociation buffer to preserve surface epitopes. Fc receptors were blocked for 10 minutes on ice before staining. Cells were stained with a nine-colour surface panel for 30 minutes at 4 C in the dark, washed twice, and resuspended in buffer containing a viability dye. Compensation was performed with single-stained beads for each fluorophore. Gating was applied on singlet, viable, lineage-positive events, with gates set on fluorescence-minus-one controls. At least 50000 events were collected per sample. SYNTHETIC SAMPLE DATA. This paper does not exist.
